issues.description: Extraction unconditionally requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo contains no story corpus, so demo and integration extraction fail.
The end-to-end tiny test depends on missing repository data and currently fails before validation or steering can run.
Checked-in demo artifacts reference source story metadata that is absent from the current repository, making outputs stale and unreproducible.
HF preference_logit does not perform pairwise preference evaluation and instead compares next-token logits for 'good' vs 'bad' after a score prompt.
When tokenizer offsets are unavailable, steering falls back to every prompt token rather than the activity tokens, changing behavior by tokenizer implementation.
Validation loads vector artifacts without checking backend, model, layer count, or d_model compatibility with the configured backend.
Preference steering loads vector artifacts without validating manifest compatibility before using them with the configured backend.
If correlations do not produce four emotions, the code silently uses the first four emotions, weakening the reported steering validation.
A PCA variance threshold of 0 still returns one component, so requesting no variance removal unexpectedly projects out an axis.
Config scale fields are not validated, so empty or malformed emotion/topic/story settings fail later with unclear extraction errors.
HuggingFace model and tokenizer downloads are not pinned to a revision, making full runs non-reproducible across time.
Runtime dependencies are broad lower bounds with no lock or constraints file, which undermines reproducibility for a research/demo pipeline.
